item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "Ishq-e-Haider Mein Salman Apni Jagah Mir Hasan Mir"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Wafa"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Ishq e Haider Mein Salman Apni Jagah Mir Hasan Mir.
Par Nuseri Ka Irfan Apni Jagah.
Baab-e-Janat Pe Rizwan Apni Jagah.
Bait-e-Zahra Ka Darban Apni Jagah.

2
Aayatein Youn Tu Quraan Ki Sab Hain Magar.
Hukam-e-Baligh Teri Shan Apni Jagah.
Janat Achi Jagah Hai Yeh Mana Magar.
Karbala Tera Arman Apni Jagah.

3
Naza Mein Chehra-e-Murtaza Dekh Kar.
Aa Gaye Sare Osan Apni Jagah.
Kya Namaz-o-Azza Ka Taqabul Wafa.
Jism Apni Jagah Jan Apni Jagah.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ishq-e-haider-mein-salman-apni-jagah-mir-hasan-mir-tajpoints-807826918d4f6c071337.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for section, numbers in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):
    groups = section.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(groups) == 3
    for group, number in zip(groups, numbers):
        lines = group.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == number
        assert all(not line.endswith('.') for line in lines)
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in front and 'noUrdu' not in front
print('Verified three four-verse stanzas in Urdu and Roman.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that all three stanzas align at four verses each. Set the direction to RTL and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “Hukam-e-Baligh” as `حکمِ بَلِّغ` and retained “Mir Hasan Mir” where it appeared in the imported title and opening line.
